C0633.title: Taobao Duplicate Listing Rules and Penalty Measures
C0633.summary: A Maijiawang article summarizing Taobao duplicate listing rules explains that a seller may be found to have duplicate listings when the same product is repeatedly published through multiple links or split into highly similar listings by color, specification, image, or other minor variations. Taobao may delete duplicate products and, for repeated violations, delist store products, restrict product publishing, limit product quantities, or limit publishable categories.

references.title: Taobao Rules for Avoiding Duplicate Listings - Maijiawang
